verdict.rationale: Docs describe project-local skills discovered via .agents/skills scanned up to the repo root and checked into a repo per-team/folder (docs-9, docs-17), while skill-installer is described as installing skills for your own local Codex setup (docs-8, docs-14), implying a separate user-level install path distinct from repo-committed files. However, no doc explicitly frames these as a chosen scope option or documents where the user-global config is stored versus project files. missing for 10: explicit scope toggle/flag documentation, clear description of user-global storage location, and confirmation both scopes coexist per-plugin (not just skills)
